sys hypervisor-info(1)					BIG-IP TMSH Manual				    sys hypervisor-info(1)

NAME
       hypervisor-info - Used inside of a vCMP guest to display proposed configuration information passed in from the vCMP
       hypervisor.

MODULE
       sys

SYNTAX
       Access the hypervisor-info component within the sys module using the syntax in the following sections.

   DISPLAY
	show hypervisor-info
	  options:
	    field-fmt

DESCRIPTION
       You can use the hypervisor-info component to display vCMP guest configuration information proposed by the vCMP hypervisor.
       Note that this component will only display information when used from inside a vCMP guest. On any other BIG-IP system, the
       show command will produce no output.

       These values will override the default values for any of the corresponding configuration items inside the guest:

       Proposed Address - The management IP, as configured via tmsh sys management-ip on appliances and via tmsh sys cluster on
       clusters.

       Proposed Gateway - The default gateway, as configured via tmsh sys management-route.

       Proposed Hostname - The hostname, as configured via tmsh sys global-settings.

       Proposed Netmask - The management netmask. See "Proposed Address" above.

EXAMPLES
       show hypervisor-info

       Displays hypervisor configuration information in default units.

OPTIONS
       For information about the options that you can use with the command show, see help show.

SEE ALSO
       show, tmsh
